notes: Triangle TP3 on the promoted 1120 recipe: nvidia01 rank0, fx103 rank1, dell01 rank2 over three direct CX7 links (two PCIe paths each). The site keeps its own serving options, port 8888 for the client and gateway, the newest-six image window mounted into site-packages, the site's management interface for collectives, this head node as rendezvous, the site's GitHub mirror as deployment repository and the JIT cache inside the checkout. Every other serving argument, the prefill budget, the KV pool and the generation defaults come from the recipe unchanged. fan_control is off on these non-NVIDIA GB10 boards.

glp.notes: msuiche's published GLP-27 vector for v41-flash-1017 (27 layers L11-37, alpha_default 3.5, gated repository). Served at the file's alpha; requests to the steered name only.
